prerequisites: Basic computer science courses, e.g., Fundamentals of Computer Science module
Knowledge of a programming language is desirable

learning_outcomes.text: Students understand the importance of databases and can differentiate their use.
Students learn the procedure for creating a data model and can implement it in a specific database.
Students learn how to access relational databases with SQL and develop applications based on a database.

Participants acquire knowledge of performance optimization for data storage and access and understand the interaction of application, presentation, and database servers in programming, especially in a web environment.
Students understand the concepts of databases and their use.
Students are able to understand, criticize, and complement the database designs of their colleagues through their own contributions.
Students have the ability to create software using a database.
Students can implement their own software engineering ideas with the help of databases and defend them against competing approaches.

syllabus_topics: SQLite, a database for your pocket
assessment_rules: The module examination is a written examination of 90 minutes. The weighting of the grade is 5/210.
